data_policy.source: byte-for-byte copies of validated HR-1 v8 materialized data and schedules

training.cadence: 9 English updates then 1 binding update, repeated for 50 cycles
training.english_schedule_reuse: literal inherited schedule; no regeneration or reshuffle
training.binding_schedule_reuse: literal inherited schedule; no regeneration or reshuffle

english_objective.target: y = z[1:] at the same tensor positions
english_objective.ignored: padding input is 0; padding labels, BOS, and no other positions are -100
english_objective.supervised: all content-token targets plus the single final EOS
english_objective.loss: mean full-vocabulary cross-entropy over non-ignored labels

training.dev_objective: identical x/y construction and cross-entropy expression as English training
training.binding_objective: pinned Pilot-1 answer causal CE plus hard-min permutation-invariant localization objective; LAM=1.0536573711078283
training.english_scope: train token/position embeddings, blocks 4-7, final normalization, language head; freeze blocks 0-3 and localizer/retrieval

optimizer.persistence: one fresh optimizer per run, continuous across all update types

runtime_policy.rng: random, torch CPU and CUDA seeded with 87006

evaluation.binding_pools: evaluate Pilot-0 and Pilot-1 nonsacred pools separately; never average
evaluation.final_readiness_battery: sealed and inaccessible; no construction, derivation, or evaluation here

stopping.checkpoint_selection: only among update 100/500 checkpoints using frozen nonsacred DEV criteria; no retrospective gate changes

scientific_delta.only_intended_correction: correct BOS/next-token/EOS tensor alignment in English training and DEV loss
scientific_delta.parent: Pilot 1 is used explicitly per approved forensic correction
scientific_delta.unchanged: data, schedule, batch sizes, optimizer, scope, cadence, binding rehearsal/objective, metrics, gates, and sealed-material restrictions
